lore_anchors.definition: A low-grade mental confusion technique used to disorient or embarrass a target; attempting it on a vastly superior cultivator triggers a dangerous magical backlash.
The dangerous consequence of a failed or countered spell, which rebounds on the caster with amplified force, often causing severe mental or physical damage.
The second major stage in cultivation, representing a massive qualitative leap in power and lifespan; a Foundation Establishment cultivator is leagues above any Qi Condensation practitioner.
The first stage of cultivation, focused on gathering and refining spiritual qi; cultivators at this stage are still bound by many mortal limitations.
A basic perception spell that reveals a target's magic power and cultivation level; can be fooled or rendered ineffective by a sufficiently higher-level cultivator.
